## Six steps

```{=html}
<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">1<small>~15 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>📐 Memorize the formula bank</h3>
    <p>Open the Formula Bank. Read every section once. Mark the 10–12 formulas that feel easiest to remember. Close the page and recite them aloud.</p>
    <div class="actions"><a href="formula-bank.html" class="primary">Open Formula Bank</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">2<small>~75 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>📝 Walk the practice exam</h3>
    <p>Open the Practice Walkthrough. Read each problem, attempt it on paper, then check the worked solution. Five sections — MC, Bond, SCF, Job-Order, CVP. The patterns repeat.</p>
    <div class="actions"><a href="practice-walkthrough.html" class="primary">Open Walkthrough</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">3<small>~60 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>✏️ Re-do the practice exam without looking</h3>
    <p>Same practice exam. Cover the solutions. Time yourself. Compare after. The second pass is when retrieval becomes automatic.</p>
    <div class="actions"><a href="practice-walkthrough.html">Open Walkthrough (cover the solutions)</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">4<small>~10 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>🌱 Read the Smallest Version</h3>
    <p>The five-section spine, condensed. One formula chain per section, one decision rule per section. If the patterns from the practice walkthrough are still fresh, this page locks them in.</p>
    <div class="actions"><a href="smallest-version.html" class="primary">Open Smallest Version</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">5<small>15 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>🌬 Walk and breathe</h3>
    <p>Close the laptop. Take a real walk — outside or up a stairwell — for fifteen minutes. No phone, no notes. The material is in. The walk lets it settle.</p>
    <div class="actions"><a href="../reset.html">Open Reset (if you'd rather sit)</a></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="eday-step">
  <div class="num">6<small>5 min</small></div>
  <div>
    <h3>📋 The 30-minute formula spine, before you walk in</h3>
    <p>Right before the exam, glance through the spine below. Don't read anything new. Drink water.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```

## The 30-minute formula spine

```{=html}
<section class="eday-spine">
  <h2>The ten things you need cold</h2>
  <ol>
    <li><strong>Bond interest expense</strong> = NBV × MARKET rate (not coupon rate).</li>
    <li><strong>Bond premium vs discount</strong>: premium → coupon &gt; market → total interest expense LOWER than total coupons. Discount = opposite.</li>
    <li><strong>SCF sign rule</strong>: current assets opposite (AR up = cash use). Current liabilities same (AP up = cash source).</li>
    <li><strong>SCF cash from PPE sale</strong> = NBV − Loss. NBV = Cost − Accum Dep.</li>
    <li><strong>SCF dividends paid</strong> = Beg RE + NI − End RE.</li>
    <li><strong>Predetermined OH rate</strong> = ESTIMATED OH ÷ ESTIMATED base. <strong>Allocated OH</strong> = Predetermined rate × ACTUAL base.</li>
    <li><strong>Product cost</strong> (capitalized): DM + DL + factory MOH. <strong>Period cost</strong> (expensed): corporate, sales, customer service, admin.</li>
    <li><strong>Breakeven</strong> = Fixed Costs ÷ Unit CM. Round UP.</li>
    <li><strong>Target profit units</strong> = (Fixed Costs + Target Profit) ÷ Unit CM.</li>
    <li><strong>Stock split</strong> = SE unchanged. <strong>Stock repurchase</strong> = SE decreases (treasury = contra-equity).</li>
  </ol>
</section>
```

## In the room

```{=html}
<div class="eday-mini">
  <div>
    <h4>Read first</h4>
    <ul>
      <li>Skim all 5 sections before answering anything</li>
      <li>Start with the section you're most confident on</li>
      <li>Bond Q1 (coupon rate) is usually a freebie — get it first</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h4>SCF discipline</h4>
    <ul>
      <li>Do CFO step by step in the recipe order</li>
      <li>Always check: CFO + CFI + CFF = ΔCash</li>
      <li>Loss = add-back. Gain = subtract.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h4>Job-Order discipline</h4>
    <ul>
      <li>Predetermined uses ESTIMATED</li>
      <li>Allocated uses Predetermined × ACTUAL</li>
      <li>Anything corporate = period cost (not in MOH)</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h4>If stuck</h4>
    <ul>
      <li>Move on. Come back at the end.</li>
      <li>Show your work — partial credit is real</li>
      <li>Round up for unit answers (you can't sell 7,241.38)</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>
```

You have the spine. Walk in.
